description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning) v2], [Awoken Black Magic], [Damage Cap +10000], [Instant Cast 1], [Bluff Mode] and [True Thunderstorm] to the user

description.name: Awoken Black Magic
description.text: Black Magic abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Bluff Mode
description.text: Casts Black Magic Bluff after using four Fire, Ice or Lightning abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: Black Magic Bluff
description.text: Ten single attacks (2.00 each), followed by one single attack (11.00) capped at 99999

description.name: True Thunderstorm
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] to the user after using three Fire, Ice or Lightning abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Ice/Lightning damage

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%
